components.name: Aurora Badge
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A pill badge with a slowly rotating conic-gradient aurora border and a soft, pulsing ambient glow.

components.name: Lightbulb Switch
components.author: JkHuger
components.description: A toggle whose knob is a lightbulb with a threaded screw base; it flips 180° and lights up warm yellow when on.

components.name: Day / Night Toggle
components.author: rishichawda
components.description: Pure-SVG theme switch: sun sets into a cratered moon, cloud fades out, eight stars fade in, sky shifts to night blue.

components.name: Elastic Slider
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: An accessible range slider with a violet gradient fill, an elastic thumb that stretches while dragging, and a floating value bubble that springs in above it.

components.name: Filament Bulb Button
components.author: marcelodolza
components.description: Skeuomorphic lightbulb: steel screw base, glass envelope with noise + specular reflex, glowing filament wires up when checked. Get Started flips to Time to Shine.

components.name: Flip Clock
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A live HH:MM:SS split-flap clock with six folding digit cards, a two-stage 300ms flap animation, and instant swaps under reduced motion.

components.name: Hold to Delete
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A destructive-action button that demands a deliberate 1.2-second press-and-hold, sweeping a red progress fill before popping into a satisfying Deleted state.

components.name: Liquid Tabs
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A dark segmented control whose glass pill springs between Preview, Code, and Ship with overshoot easing, roving-tabindex keyboard support, and reduced-motion fallbacks.

components.name: Magnetic Button
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A pill button that magnetically drifts toward the cursor with a parallax inner label and a pointer-following radial sheen, then springs back to rest on leave.

components.name: Morph Search
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A 44px circular search button that morphs into a 260px input pill with auto-focus, a clear action, and a cyan focus glow, fully keyboard operable.

components.name: Particle Burst Button
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A violet-gradient Celebrate button that fires a pooled, gravity-driven confetti burst and ring shockwave on click, hard-capped at 80 live particles.

components.name: Retro Press Button
components.author: arthur_6104
components.description: Physical keycap: a gray base shows as depth, and :active collapses the padding so the face presses down 10px.

components.name: Send Message Button
components.author: marcelodolza
components.description: Neumorphic button: letters cascade in, paper plane takes off with a contrail on send, check-mark Sent state lands. Improved: JS class state instead of :focus so it survives blur.

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A dark glass card whose cursor-tracking radial spotlight washes the surface and ignites a matching 1px border glow, fading out smoothly on pointer leave.

components.name: Terminal Typing
components.author: prism/ui
components.description: A mini macOS terminal that types a prism-ui install command with human-like jitter, prints green-check output lines, and loops on a blinking block cursor.

components.name: Circle Fill Button
components.author: mrhyddenn
components.description: Outlined social button; a giant circle's inset shadow floods the fill from the center on hover.

components.name: YOU Stroke Loader
components.author: SelfMadeSystem
components.description: Three letters drawn in animated gradient strokes; the O spins with an eased 8s rotation cycle.
